rows.en: Man, there's no end to these guys.
What the hell!! There's no end to these guys, dammit!!
At this rate, it'll never end!!
At this rate, there will be no end to this!!
What do we do...!?
...Ngh. But the mission... will be completed!!
...Ngh. But I have to do this! I am Gundam!
...Gah! But I can't afford to lose here!!
...Ngh. But all they've got is numbers...!!
...Ugh... I won't let them look down on me!!
...Gah! Fine, then I'll go all the way with this!!
...Ugh... Do we have no choice but to fight!?
...Guh. But if we don't do this...!!
...Guh. But we have to do this!!
...Guh. But... fighting is the only way!!
...Ugh. If it's come to this, we just have to do it, right!!
...Tch. So we've got no choice but to do it!?
...Whoa there. Fine, then I'll keep you company till the bitter end!!
...Guh. If it's come to this, we have no choice!!
...Guh. If it's come to this, we have no choice!!
Hold on!!
...Cherudim!
The Virgo squad. Didn't think there were still this many of them. But it's as I expected.
Alright! Leave these guys to us!!
What? The same pattern again?
No! Fighting them blindly will only wear us down!
Then what are we supposed to do!?
There must be a commander somewhere!!
Huh? A commander? What do you mean?
The way this Virgo squad moves... I can't believe they're ordinary mobile dolls.
I see... So you're saying someone, somewhere, is remotely controlling the Virgo squad?
That's right. Seravee, does anything come to mind?
Actually, I sensed quantum brainwaves a moment ago. There's probably an Innovator nearby...
That's it! If an Innovator is their commander, those tactical movements make sense.
Alright! Then Seravee and the Hero Team, find this commander of theirs and take them down!!
Roger.
Once the op's done and the Virgo squad goes silent, we'll head on ahead of you, got it?
Roger. We'll follow right after you.
There are too many enemies this way!!
Take another route!!
I'll hold them off here!
Take another route!!
Take another route!!
I'll take care of things over here!
You people...!!
...Gaddess!! It's you, isn't it!? You're the mobile dolls' commander!!
Heh heh heh heh. That's right... But how did you figure it out!?
Movements far too tactical for mobile dolls. And then, the quantum brainwaves...
That's how I knew. That an Innovator was controlling them from somewhere.
Hmm, you've got good instincts, don't you? But no matter how good they are, you can't defeat me!!
Go!! Fangs!!
Ahahahahaha!! I'll show you just how much stronger I am!!
Gaddess!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Gaddess!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Gaddess!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Don't give me that!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Gaddess!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Gaddess!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Gaddess!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Gaddess!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Gaddess!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Gaddess!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Sorry, Gaddess!! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
Now that's interesting!! But you're the one who's gonna learn who's stronger, got it!?
We'll see about that!? You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!!
I'll throw those words right back at you!! Gaddess! You're the one who's about to learn who's stronger!
Good!! Destroy the control device further in!!
{8074} destroyed the mobile dolls' control device.
...Look what you've done.
You!! So you were still alive, damn you!!
Me, defeated... There must be some mistake!!
...Fangs!!
Look!! I can still fight...!! I...
...Hm? Yes... Understood...

notes.note: #0.13-16 are the tail of the 15-slot leader block #0.2-16. Pt_Chara_Check chain in 0605.bla is 9,10,8,6,7,15,14,13,12,11,5,4,3,2,1 = Wing Zero, 00, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W(Shotaro), Momotaros, RX, Rider 1; so #0.13 Shotaro, #0.14 Momotaros, #0.15 RX, #0.16 Rider 1. The order matches the wording (#0.20 'mission' = Heero, #0.21 'I am Gundam' = Setsuna).
#0.20-34 second 15-slot leader block, same chain order (Wing Zero ... Rider 1); the leader groans after a Virgo beam volley. #0.33-34 identical Japanese -> identical English.
Mebius slot; subject of the 'no choice but to' tail restored as 'we'. Same tail as #0.31 (Shotaro) with a different interjection; #0.31 voiced rougher.
Momotaros slot; 'tokoton tsukiatte yaru' (stick with it to the end) rendered 'keep you company till the bitter end'.
Cherudim arriving with the Gundam allies; 'matsu n da' read as 'Hold on' (stop the hopeless fight), not a plea to wait for him.
Ankh refers to 0603, where the allies also stayed behind to hold off enemies while the heroes went ahead.
00 term for brain quantum waves rendered with the glossary's 'quantum brainwaves'. 'Innovator' (00 English) not in glossary; used the franchise name.
'senkou suru' = Cherudim's group moves on ahead once the Virgos fall silent; Seravee answers it will follow right after.
Gaddess's 'Fang' = her GN Fangs (glossary note); kept short as 'Fangs'.
'chikara no chigai' (difference in power) rendered as 'who's stronger' so Gaddess's taunt and the leader replies (#0.12-26) mirror each other.

#0.12-26 15-slot leader block; 0609.bla chain is 10,9,8,6,7,15,14,13,12,11,5,4,3,2,1 = 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, Shotaro, Momotaros, RX, Rider 1. Identical Japanese -> identical English. #0.15 (Nu) opens with 'Don't give me that!!'; #0.23 Shotaro's 'warii na' = sarcastic 'Sorry'.
Name variable + padding -> tag only; no 'tachi' in this line so no 'and the team'.
'yatte kureta wa ne' read as spiteful 'Look what you've done' (the control device was destroyed).
Gaddess is receiving orders via quantum brainwaves (Seravee/Ankh comment on it in the next slice).

report: 80/80 rows translated. Leader blocks (0605 #0.13-16 tail, #0.20-34; 0609 #0.12-26) mapped by the Pt_Chara_Check chains in 0605.bla/0609.bla. Not in glossary: 'Innovator' (00 franchise term). Uncertain: 0605 #0.35 'Hold on' reading; 0609 #0.34 'Look what you've done'.
